description:
Read one integration

Returns a single integration including its stored `config`, with every secret value replaced by `********`. A value counts as secret when its field is declared with type `password` for the integration type, when its key contains `secret`, `password`, `passwd`, `token`, `apiKey`, `api_key`, `authorization`, `authValue`, `credential`, `bearer` or `cookie` or ends in `Key` (case-insensitive, at any depth), or when it is a URL that carries its secret inside it, such as the webhook URL of a Discord integration. A secret key covers everything below it. Booleans are never masked, and an empty value stays empty. That masking is one-way: this endpoint tells you which credential fields are populated, never what they contain, and there is no endpoint that reveals them. The masked config can be sent back unchanged with PATCH: a secret sent as `********` keeps its stored value. `config` comes back as a JSON string and has to be parsed. Internal connector and health bookkeeping is not returned, and neither are the connection keys only the server writes into `config`.

id.description: Identifier of the integration. A non-numeric value is rejected with 400.
